calls.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished color reveal illustration for a curated nonogram game, square canvas. Motif: Yin-Yang / taijitu. Warm calm hand-drawn 2D illustration, clean carefully drawn contours, strong coherent color areas, tasteful restrained shading and material details, quiet warm ivory background. Centered entire circular symbol, clear authentic taijitu geometry: two interlocking equal comma lobes separated by an S curve, exactly one contrasting circular dot within each lobe. No writing, labels, watermark, grid, pixel art, scenery or unrelated decorations. This is detailed finished reveal art, not a puzzle matrix. Maintain excellent silhouette readability for later monochrome abstraction at approximately 25 cells wide. Variant A: front-facing flat circular ceramic medallion, midnight indigo lobe and warm ivory lobe, fine muted ochre outer contour, subtle cobalt glaze variations and restrained tiny surface marks. Minimal depth, no oblique perspective. Symbol dominates image.
